description: Source code for parsing and managing Certificate Revocation List (CRL) sets in Chromium, including functions for reading headers, serials, and verifying SPKI hashes, with embedded test data and constants.

classes.name: CRLSet
classes.description: Represents a set of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) with methods for parsing, validation, and testing.

methods.name: CRLSet::Parse
methods.description: Parses a CRL set from binary data, extracting header info and CRL entries.

methods.name: CRLSet::CheckSPKI
methods.description: Checks if a given SPKI hash is revoked.

methods.name: CRLSet::CheckSubject
methods.description: Checks if a subject and SPKI hash combination is revoked.

methods.name: CRLSet::CheckSerial
methods.description: Checks if a serial number issued by a given issuer SPKI is revoked.

methods.name: CRLSet::IsKnownInterceptionKey
methods.description: Determines if a given SPKI hash is a known interception key.

methods.name: CRLSet::IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CRL set has expired based on 'NotAfter' timestamp.

methods.name: CRLSet::sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the CRL set.

methods.name: CRLSet::CrlsForTesting
methods.description: Returns the internal CRL list for testing purposes.

methods.name: CRLSet::BuiltinCRLSet
methods.description: Returns a built-in, default CRL set.

methods.name: CRLSet::EmptyCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an empty CRL set for testing.

methods.name: CRLSet::ExpiredCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an expired CRL set for testing.

methods.name: CRLSet::ForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CRL set with specified test parameters.
